visualCharacteristics.summary: Square image tiles with a dark translucent caption box over the bottom-left of the image. | Same square image tiles with dark caption overlays as A UN CLIC, so cards-tiles is reused.

contentPattern.notes: Look-alike image-and-caption tiles in a grid that wraps. | Each item links to an event detail page and the set rotates. That makes it a dynamic list, so Cards.

usage: Service shortcuts (A un clic) and agenda activities: an even grid of square photo tiles, whole tile clickable.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any image-and-short-caption link grid. Use cards-news-mosaic when one item should be featured.
